error_reader.name: Error reader
error_reader.when: She fixed a compile error by reading the message herself, with no hint above level 1.

boundary_hunter.name: Boundary hunter
boundary_hunter.when: She found or explained a boundary bug (> vs >=, < vs <=) herself, like a bug report.

equals_not_double_equals.name: equals, never ==
equals_not_double_equals.when: She explained in her own words, on the first try, why == is wrong for Strings.

stack_trace_detective.name: Stack-trace detective
stack_trace_detective.when: She found her own line in a stack trace and fixed the bug without a level-3 hint.

self_searcher.name: Self-searcher
self_searcher.when: She found an answer in the docs or a web search herself before asking for a hint.
